BALUCHISTAN QAZIS AND MEMBERS, MAJLIS﷓E﷓SHOORA
(APPOINTMENT AND CONDITIONS OF SERVICE) RULES, 1980
BALUCHISTAN QAZIS AND MEMBERS, MAJLIS‑E‑SHOORA
(APPOINTMENT AND CONDITIONS OF SERVICE) RULES, 1980
[Gazette of
Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 7th April, 1980]
No. SOR(2)90/S & GAD/79.‑In exercise of the
powers conferred by Para. 6 of the Baluchistan Civil Disputes (Shariat
Application) Regulation, 1976, the Government of Baluchistan is pleased to make
the following rules regulating the recruitment to the Baluchistan Civil Service
(Qazis and Members, Majlis‑e‑Shoora) and prescribe conditions of
service for the persons appointed thereto, namely :‑-----
1. Short title and commencement.‑(a) These rules may
be called the Baluchistan Qazis and Members, Majlis‑e‑Shoora
(Appointment and Condi tions of Service) Rules, 1980.
(b) They shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.‑(a) "Government" means the
Government of Baluchistan.
(b) "High Court" means the High Court of
Baluchistan.
(c) "Chief Justice" means the Chief Justice of
High Court of Baluchistan. (d) "Commission" means the Baluchistan
Public Service Commission.
(e) "Initial Recruitment" means appointment made
otherwise than by promotion and/or transfer from other service/department/post.
(f ) "Service" means Baluchistan Civil Services
(Qazis and Members, Majlis‑e‑Shoora).
(g) The term and words used in these Rules but not defined
shall have the same meaning as assigned to them in the Baluchistan Civil
Servants Act, 1974.
3. Constitution and composition of service.‑The
Service shall comprise of two grades ; the upper grade comprising of the post
of Member, Majlis‑e Shoora and lower grade comprising of the post of
Qazi.
4. Appointing authority.‑‑Appointment to the
service shall be made by the Government.
5. Method of recruitment.‑Recruitment to the service
shall be trade in the following manner :‑
(a) In the case of Qazis by initial recruitment on the
recommendation of the Commission ;
(b) In the case of Members Majlis‑e‑Shoora :‑
(i) two‑third vacancies by selection on merit with
due regard to seniority from among the Qazis ; and
(ii) one‑third by initial recruitment on the
recommendation of the Commission.
(c) Ad hoc appointments of Qazis and Members Majlis‑e‑Shoora
shall be made on the recommendations of the High Court.
6. Age.‑No person, who is less than 28 years or more
than 40 years of age, relaxable up to 5 years, shall be appointed to the
service by initial recruitment.
7. Qualifications.‑----(a) No person shall be
appointed as Qazi by initial recruitment unless he possesses Sanad/Darse Nizami
from a recognized Darul Ulum (preferably English knowing) or is Law Graduate
from a recognised University and having practised for at least 3 years as an
Advocate or pleader.
(b) No person shall be appointed as a Member, Majlis‑e‑Shoora
by initial recruitment unless he possesses Sanad/Darse Nizami from a recognised
Darul Ulum (preferably English knowing) or is Law Graduate from a recognised
University having practised for at least 5 years as an Advocate.
8. Probation.‑(a) The persons appointed to the
service shall remain on probation for a period of one year in the first
instance.
(b) If the work or conduct of the member of service during
the period of probation has been unsatisfactory, the Government shall, on the
recom mendations of the Chief Justice, notwithstanding the period of probation
has not expired, dispense with the services of that candidate ;
(c) On completion of the period of probation of the Member
of the service, subject to. the availability of substantive vacancy, confirm
him in his appointment on the recommendation of the Chief Justice. If his work
or conduct is, in the opinion of the Chief Justice, not satisfactory, may
recommend to the Government to dispense with his services or extend the period
of probation not exceeding by one year.
(d) If no orders are passed by the day following the day of
expiry of initial period of probation, the period of probation shall be
